WarriorSim.// HOSTS: Exact hosts, never substrings - this is the safety boundary that keeps a trading chord off a look-alike page. Warrior moved the SIM from sim to sim2 on 2026-08-21 without notice and every key stopped working, so both are accepted. If they move it again, add the new one to AllowedHost in YOUR file (%LOCALAPPDATA%\WarriorHotkeyBridge\Configuration\appsettings.json) - it adds to this list rather than replacing it.

Hotkeys.//: Deliberately empty. Every binding belongs to the operator, in the user file at %LOCALAPPDATA%\WarriorHotkeyBridge\Configuration\appsettings.json. Configuration layers merge per key, not per object, so a binding shipped here and rebound there merges into one entry carrying BOTH Send and Action - which the resolver rejects, breaking the key. F23 and F24 shipped as Test and Diagnostics on the assumption that nobody would rebind spare keys; rebinding them cost the operator the key and put the defaults back on every restart. Test is a button in the hotkey editor and Diagnostics is a tray menu item, so neither needs to cost a deck key.
